sections.title: Quests
sections.note: Side quests not already a row in another tracker.

items.name: Mrs. Marie's Joy Pendants
items.notes: Bokoblins carry Joy Pendants (steal them with the Grappling Hook), and dungeons and caves have a few in chests. Don't sell them to Beedle until you have 40.

tiers.name: First Joy Pendant
tiers.howTo: After the Killer Bees' hide-and-seek, apologise to Mrs. Marie for them, then roll into the tree by the Bomb Shop for the pendant they hid and give it to her.

tiers.name: 40 Joy Pendants
tiers.reward: Hero's Charm (Treasure Chart 45 in Wind Waker HD)

items.name: Mail Sorting
items.notes: The Piece of Heart from Baito's mother is in Heart Pieces.

tiers.name: Koboli's test
tiers.howTo: Ask Koboli for the part-time job and sort at least 10 letters in 30 seconds.

tiers.name: Baito's 25 letters
tiers.howTo: Come back after Dragon Roost Cavern and sort 25 letters in one round while Baito watches.

tiers.name: Note to Mom
tiers.howTo: Post the Note to Mom Baito gives you; his mother's reply brings a Piece of Heart.

items.name: Lenzo's pictographs
items.notes: The Gallery's figurines need the colour pictographs of the Deluxe Picto Box.

tiers.name: Picto Box
tiers.howTo: Free Tingle from the jail behind Lenzo's house and crawl through the maze behind his cell to the Picto Box.

tiers.name: Lenzo's three tasks
tiers.howTo: Show Lenzo the box and take the three pictographs he asks for around Windfall.

tiers.name: Deluxe Picto Box
tiers.howTo: Bring Lenzo a Forest Firefly in a Bottle from Forest Haven.

items.name: Maggie's Father's Skull Necklaces
items.howTo: Bring Maggie's Father 20 Skull Necklaces, the Moblins' spoils.
items.after: After the second visit to the Forsaken Fortress
items.notes: He tips Rupees for any more. Treasure Chart 2 leads to a Piece of Heart.

items.name: Hoskit's Golden Feathers
items.howTo: Give Hoskit 20 Golden Feathers, dropped by Peahats, Kargarocs and winged Mothulas.
items.notes: His girlfriend's letter afterwards holds a Piece of Heart (in Heart Pieces).

items.name: Orca's Knight's Crests
items.howTo: Bring Orca 10 Knight's Crests from Darknuts.

items.name: Mila's night walk
items.howTo: Follow Mila from the potion shop at night without being seen and catch her at Zunari's safe.
items.after: After the second visit to the Forsaken Fortress

items.name: Traveling Merchants
items.area: Greatfish Isle, Mother and Child Isles and Bomb Island
items.howTo: Trade decorations between the three merchants, starting with a Town Flower from Zunari, up to the Shop Guru Statue; trade it on Greatfish Isle for a Piece of Heart.
items.notes: Each merchant trades three times a day. Zunari gives the Magic Armor along the way, and his shop stocks each new decoration for Windfall's decorations. The Piece of Heart is also in Heart Pieces.

sections.title: Withered Trees
sections.note: Water all eight in one go: Forest Water turns ordinary after 20 minutes (30 in Wind Waker HD). The last one gives a Piece of Heart.

items.name: Oakin's tree
items.howTo: Sprinkle Forest Water from Forest Haven on the withered sapling Oakin planted on Star Island.

items.name: Rown's tree
items.howTo: Sprinkle Forest Water from Forest Haven on the withered sapling Rown planted on Mother and Child Isles.

items.name: Olivio's tree
items.howTo: Sprinkle Forest Water from Forest Haven on the withered sapling Olivio planted on Eastern Fairy Island.

items.name: Linder's tree
items.howTo: Sprinkle Forest Water from Forest Haven on the withered sapling Linder planted on Greatfish Isle.

items.name: Elma's tree
items.howTo: Sprinkle Forest Water from Forest Haven on the withered sapling Elma planted on Needle Rock Isle.

items.name: Drona's tree
items.howTo: Sprinkle Forest Water from Forest Haven on the withered sapling Drona planted on Private Oasis.

items.name: Irch's tree
items.howTo: Sprinkle Forest Water from Forest Haven on the withered sapling Irch planted on Shark Island.

items.name: Aldo's tree
items.howTo: Sprinkle Forest Water from Forest Haven on the withered sapling Aldo planted on Cliff Plateau Isles.

sections.title: Tingle Statues
sections.note: Five gold statues hidden in the dungeons.

items.name: Dragon Tingle Statue
items.howTo: Find the hidden spot in Dragon Roost Cavern and bomb it to reveal the statue's chest.
items.notes: GameCube: the spot shows only on the Tingle Tuner (Game Boy Advance link), and Tingle's own bomb reveals it. Wind Waker HD has no hint; a normal Bomb works.

items.name: Forbidden Tingle Statue
items.howTo: Find the hidden spot in Forbidden Woods and bomb it to reveal the statue's chest.
items.notes: GameCube: the spot shows only on the Tingle Tuner (Game Boy Advance link), and Tingle's own bomb reveals it. Wind Waker HD has no hint; a normal Bomb works.

items.name: Ankle's reward
items.howTo: Talk to Ankle once the statues stand on Tingle Island: 50 Rupees each, and 500 more for all five.
items.notes: In Wind Waker HD Knuckle also turns up on Tingle Island after all five.
